note: Fixed-departure group tour rules. The ONLY source of this wording for the Terms page, the cancellation policy, the checkout and the voucher. {advance_percent}, {balance_due_days}, {refund_days} and {processing_fee_percent} are filled from Group tour settings (Django admin), or the departure's own advance; the cancellation amounts follow bookings/refunds.py. Lines with {processing_fee_percent} are left out while the charge is 0. An identical copy lives in GokeysNext/bookings/group_departure_terms.json. Change both together; npm test compares them.
payment: Pay an advance of {advance_percent}% of the total to confirm your seats, or pay the full amount at booking.
The balance is due {balance_due_days} days before departure. Your booking shows the exact date and amount.
Each online payment (advance, full amount or balance) has a payment processing charge of {processing_fee_percent}% of that payment, shown as its own line before you pay.
cancellation: If you cancel 30 or more days before departure, we keep ₹2,000 per person and refund the rest of what you paid.
If you cancel 7 to 29 days before departure, we keep the advance ({advance_percent}% of the total) and refund anything you paid above it.
If you cancel less than 7 days before departure, or do not show up, there is no refund.
The payment processing charge ({processing_fee_percent}%) is not refunded when you cancel. If Gokeys cancels a departure, it is refunded with everything else.

To cancel, open Check my booking on gokeys.in and confirm with the code we email you. Your booking is cancelled at once and its seats are released; any refund due under these rules is paid within 7 working days after approval.
You may transfer your seat to another person free of charge up to 7 days before departure.

You may move to another date of the same tour once free of charge up to 15 days before departure. After that, each change costs ₹500 per person plus any fare difference. Dates cannot be changed less than 7 days before departure: that counts as a cancellation.
minimumGroup: Each departure runs with a minimum number of travellers. We confirm every date by its decision date.

If a date does not reach the minimum, Gokeys cancels it and you choose: a 100% refund within {refund_days} working days, a move to another departure of any group tour at no fee (any fare difference is paid or refunded), or running it as a private trip by paying the difference.
